content: Lmuɛjiza tamezwarut di Qana
Deg wass wiss třata temsar ict n tmeɣra di Qana, ict n tendint di Ljalil. Tuɣa din yemmas n Yasuɛ.
Uřa d Yasuɛ d imeḥḍaren nnes ttwaɛarḍen-dd ɣar tmeɣra.
Řami iqḍa binu, tenna as yemmas i Yasuɛ: “War ɣarsen bu binu!”
Yasuɛ inna as: “Min din jar ayi akidem, a tamɣart? Tasaɛɛet inu war dd-tiwiḍ ɛad!”
Yemmas tenna i imsexxaren: “Min d awem i ɣa yini, ggem t.”
Tuɣa din setta n iqeddwaḥ n weẓru daysen aman, mmarsen dinni am mammec nnumen tteggen Wudayen řuḍu, kuř ijjen zzaysen ɣares řqedd n tnayen ař třata n ‘iribaɛen’.
Yasuɛ inna asen: “Ccurem iqeddwaḥ s waman!” Uca ccuren ten s waman ař aqemmum.
Xas uca inna asen: “Řexxu ssfarrɣem cwayt zzaysen, wcem t i bab n wurar.” Uca ssiwḍen t.
Umi bab n wurar iqeǧeb aman i idewřen d binu - maca netta war issin manis dd-ikka, maca imsexxaren nni d as dd-yuymen aman, ssnen - iřaɣa-dd bab n tmeɣra x wesři.
Inna as: “Kuř bnadem ittqeddam binu aṣebḥan d amezwaru. Mařa inewjiwen swin aṭṭas, ad asen iwc binu war iḥřin, maca cek txemmřed binu iṣebḥen ař i řexxu.”
D ta d řeɛřamet tamezwarut i igga Yasuɛ, di Qana di Ljalil. Isseḍhar-dd aɛuǧi nnes uca umnen zzayes imeḥḍaren nnes.
Awarni man aya ihwa-dd ɣar Kafarnaḥum, Netta d yemmas, d aytmas, d imeḥḍaren nnes, uca qqimen din ca n wussan.
Yasuɛ di Zzawect Tameqqrant
Řami dd-yiweḍ Řɛid n Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu, Řɛid n Wudayen, igeɛɛed Yasuɛ ɣar Urcalim.
Yufa di Zzawect Tameqqrant inni din izznuzan iyenduzen d wuǧi d idbiren, uřa d iṣarrafen n tenɛacin i din iqqimen.
Igga ijj n urekkuḍ zeg iseɣwan i Yixef nnes, uca yuẓẓeř xasen marra zi Zzawect Tameqqrant, uřa d uǧi d iyenduzen d iṣarrafen, uca izeǧeɛ iṣuldiyyen nsen di temmurt, inneqřeb ṭṭwabeř nsen.
Inna i yinni izznuzan idbiren: “Kksem man aya ssa! War ttarrim ca Taddart n Baba d taddart n ssuq!”
Xenni ɛeqřen imeḥḍaren nnes belli tura: “Cḍaret i Taddart nnec icca ayi.”
Maca Udayen arrin-dd, nnan as: “Man řeɛřamet i d aneɣ ɣa temřed, belli aqa ɣarek řḥeqq ḥima ad tegged man aya?”
Yasuɛ yarra-dd, inna asen: “Hedmem Zzawect Tameqqrant tanita uca di třata n wussan ad tt ssbeddeɣ.”
Nnan as Wudayen: “Zzawect Tameqqrant tanita tebna di setta u-rebɛin n iseggʷusa, ma Cek texsed ad tt-i-dd-tessbedded di třata n wussan?”
Maca Netta tuɣa issawař x Zzawect Tameqqrant n Arrimet nnes.
Awarni řami dd-ikkar Yasuɛ zi taddart n imettinen, ɛeqřen imeḥḍaren nnes min d asen inna, uca umnen di Tira Iqeddsen u deg wawař i inna Yasuɛ.
Umi Yasuɛ tuɣa di Urcalim, di Řɛid n Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu, umnen waṭṭas dayes řami ẓrin řeɛřamat i igga.
Maca Yasuɛ war isscen ca Ixef nnes ɣarsen, minzi Netta issen marra iwdan,
war iḥdij ca ad as iched ḥed x bnadem, minzi Netta s Yixef nnes issen min iǧan di bnadem.

footnotes.text: iribaɛen- niɣ ‘imitriten’ di tutlayt n Tyunanit. Ijj n zzaysen dayes ɛřaḥař tmanyin ař mya u-ɛicrin litru.
